unsupported: Its core services revolve around apparel decoration: screen printing for multi-color designs on t-shirts, uniforms, and other garments, and embroidery for stitched logos on polos, hats, and outerwear.
Beyond decoration, the company sources and brands a variety of promotional merchandise such as drinkware, writing instruments, bags, and other giveaway items.
The customer base spans businesses seeking branded uniforms, sports teams needing custom jerseys, schools and clubs ordering spirit wear, and organizations requiring promotional products for events.
